newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 drops at fixing led by high caps.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 drops at fixing led by high caps.

text.p: 0900 GMT - The Czech PX50 drops at Tuesday's fixing as steady bear run continues.
* Top seven most heavily weighted shares decline.
* On PX50 24 shares rise, 22 fall, four unchanged.
The Czech PX50 declined further at Tuesday's price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange with the seven most heavily capitalised shares on the index all posting losses.
SPT Telecom led the way with a 33 crown loss to 3,300, CEZ fell eight crowns to 1,022, Komercni Banka fell 10 crowns to 2,290 and Ceska Sporitelna lost four crowns to 295.
IPB lost nine crowns to 296 and Chemopetrol fell 40 crowns to 1,300.
In the broader market the picture was more positive. Most shares moved higher with brewery Radegast the biggest gainer, up 179 crowns to 3,880.
